en.ko: 윤국 할아버지의 두 손을 잡고 눈물을 흘리며

groups.note: 食い違い: 이승훈（李昇薫）を E21 は「Seung Heung Lee」と書く。E21 の「日本の官憲の手で死んだら」は英語だけ。手を取って泣いたことを英語は省く
diff: The Korean original gives the name as Yi Seung-hun (Namgang), founder of the Osan School (English edition: “Seung Heung Lee”; later spelled “Yi Sung Hun”).

The Korean original says Yi Seung-hun took both of Great-Uncle’s hands and wept as he asked him to take charge of what followed should the uprising fail; it does not mention dying at the hands of the Japanese (English edition: “in case the independence movement failed and he died at the hands of the Japanese colonial authorities”).

groups.note: E27（迫害で各地へ逃れた）は英語では次の段落の頭
漢詩は英訳と漢字の行が交互
大韓地理歌の英訳は2行に分けた所がある。E96 は「지나（中国）・ソ連の境」を「ソ連との境」だけにしている。E81・E82 の「members」は韓国語では「우리 식구들（うちの家族＝信徒）」
diff: The Korean original says the two rivers mark the border with China and the Soviet Union (English edition: “Marking a clear border with the Soviets”).
